- coins.ph / PDAX 转加密到 Maya｜Maya Support Crypto 专题（2026-10-22 查阅）：列有 How do I send crypto to Maya using PDAX? 与 How do I send crypto to Maya using Coins.ph?（均 2026-04-13） https://support.maya.ph/s/topic/0TO2y000000TTjSGAW/crypto
- GCash 护照开户｜GCash Help Center（2026-10-22 查阅）：Foreigners residing in PH with a PH SIM 接受 ACR、Driver's License、SRRV、DFA Diplomat ID、DOLE Alien Employment Permit；GTourist（Foreigners visiting PH for 30 days）接受 Foreign Passport https://help.gcash.com/hc/en-us/articles/900000948786-Accepted-IDs-for-GCash-Verification
- Chase UK 信用记录要求｜Chase UK Joining Chase（2026-10-22 查阅）：需 18+、仅英国居民、英国手机号、英国税务居民，并 meet our credit history criteria – we'll do a soft credit search to confirm this https://www.chase.co.uk/gb/en/support/joining-chase/
